notes: Buttons are consistent everywhere: every Save is green, and “+ Add …” buttons (add a person, task, to-do, reminder, group, bin…) and Start buttons are blue – in the Configurator, the phone apps, the setup wizard and the licence portal
Widget settings (Screens → click a widget): in the Family page style – a big title, “On the screen” and the widget’s own settings each in a box with a big heading, and more space

Lists you add rows to – daily to-dos, reminders, tasks, reward rules – now all look like the Family page: a box with a big heading, plain rows, “+ Add a …” underneath, then Save (green) and Undo changes side by side
Reminders is back inside Rewards; Reminders under Apps (and on Home) takes you to Rewards → Reminders
